verses.text: Don't get jealous of people who do evil, and don't wish you were hanging out with them.
Inside they're planning violence, and all they talk about is making trouble.
Wisdom builds a house. Understanding sets it on a solid footing.
Knowledge fills its rooms with all kinds of rare and beautiful treasures.
Wisdom gives a person real power. Knowledge makes them stronger still.
Get wise guidance when you go to war. Victory comes with plenty of advisers.
Wisdom is way over a fool's head. At the city gate, they've got nothing to say.
Plan to do evil and you'll get known as a schemer.
Foolish schemes are sin. People can't stand a mocker.
If you fold when things get hard, you don't have much strength.
Rescue the people being dragged off to die! Stop those who are stumbling toward the slaughter!
You might say, “Look, we didn't know.” Won't the one who weighs hearts see through that? The one who keeps your soul knows. Won't he give each person what their work deserves?
My son, eat some honey. It's good, and honey dripping from the comb tastes sweet. 🍯
Wisdom is like that for your soul. Find it and there's a reward ahead. Your hope won't get cut off.
You who do evil, don't lurk around the home of people who do right. Don't wreck the place they rest.
A person who does right may fall seven times and get back up. Disaster knocks the wicked down for good.
Don't celebrate when your enemy falls. Don't get happy inside when they go down.
The LORD could see you, be displeased, and turn his anger away from them.
Don't get worked up over people who do evil or envy the wicked.
There's no reward waiting for someone who does evil. The lamp of the wicked will go out.
My son, stand in awe of the LORD and respect the king. Don't throw in with people who rebel.
Disaster will rise up on them out of nowhere. Who knows what ruin those two can bring?
Here are more words from wise people. Playing favorites when you judge a case is wrong.
Tell wicked people, “You're in the right,” and whole peoples will curse you. Nations will despise you.
Things will go well for people who call the guilty to account, and they'll receive a rich blessing.
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
Get your work outside ready and put your fields in order. Then build your house.
Don't testify against your neighbor for no reason. Don't use your words to trick anyone.
Don't say, “I'll do to them what they did to me. I'll pay them back exactly what they earned.”
I walked past a lazy person's field, right by the vineyard of somebody with no sense.
Look, thorns had grown over everything. Nettles covered the ground and the stone wall had fallen down.
I stopped and really took it in. What I saw taught me something.
“A little more sleep, a little nap, just folding my hands to rest.”
Then poverty will jump you like a robber, and need will come at you like an armed man.
